title.english: Maymuna bint al-Harith ibn Hazn al-Hilaliyya¹

segments.arabic:
١١٧٨٣- ميمونة بنت الحارث
بن حزن الهلاليّة «١»، أخت أم الفضل لبابة.
تقدم نسبها مع أختها في حرف اللّام وميمونة في أمّ المؤمنين، كان اسمها برّة، فسماها النبيّ ﵌ ميمونة، وكانت قبل النبيّ ﵌ عند أبي رهم بن عبد العزى بن عبد ودّ بن مالك بن حسل بن عامر بن لؤيّ القرشيّ العامريّ، وقيل عند سخبرة بن أبي رهم المذكور، وقيل عند حويطب بن عبد العزّى، وقيل عند فروة أخيه، وتزوّجها رسول اللَّه ﷺ في ذي القعدة سنة سبع لما اعتمر عمرة القضيّة، فيقال: أرسل جعفر بن أبي طالب يخطبها، فأذنت للعبّاس فزوّجها منه، ويقال: إنّ العبّاس وصفها له، وقال: قد تأيّمت من أبي رهم فتزوّجها.
وقال ابن إسحاق في رواية يونس بن بكير وغيره عنه: ثم تزوج بعد صفية ميمونة، وكانت عند أبي رهم.
قال يونس بن بكير: وحدّثني جعفر بن برقان، عن ميمونة بن مهران، عن يزيد بن الأصمّ، قال: تزوّجها رسول اللَّه ﵌ وهو حلال، وبنى بها في قبة لها، وماتت بعد ذلك فيها. انتهى.
وهذا مرسل، عن ميمونة بنت خالد بن يزيد بن الأصمّ، وقد خالفه ابن خالتها الأخرى عبد اللَّه بن عبّاس، فجزم بأنه تزوّجها وهو محرم.
وهو في صحيح البخاريّ، وقد انتشر الاختلاف في هذا الحكم بين الفقهاء، ومنهم من جمع بأنه عقد عليها. وهو محرم، وبنى بها بعد أن أحلّ من عمرته بالتنعيم وهو حلال

segments.english:
11783—Maymuna bint al-Harith ibn Hazn al-Hilaliyya¹

Sister of Umm al-Fadl Lubaba.

Her lineage was given previously together with that of her sister under the letter lam, and Maymuna was mentioned under “Mother of the Believers.” Her name had been Barra, but the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) named her Maymuna. Before the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), she had been married to Abu Rahm ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Abd Wudd ibn Malik ibn Hisl ibn Amir ibn Lu'ayy al-Qurashi al-Amiri. It is also said that she had been married to the aforementioned Sakhbara ibn Abi Rahm; or to Huwaytib ibn Abd al-Uzza; or to his brother Farwa. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) married her in Dhu al-Qa'da of the seventh year, when he performed the 'umra of fulfillment ('Umrat al-Qadiyya). It is said that he sent Ja'far ibn Abi Talib to propose marriage to her, whereupon she authorized al-Abbas to act for her, and he gave her in marriage to him. It is also said that al-Abbas described her to him and said, “She has been left without a husband after Abu Rahm,” so he married her.

In the version transmitted from him by Yunus ibn Bukayr and others, ibn Ishaq said: “Then, after Safiyya, he married Maymuna, who had been married to Abu Rahm.”

Yunus ibn Bukayr said: “Ja'far ibn Burqan also related to me, from Maymun ibn Mihran, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm, who said: ‘The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) married her while free of ihram, consummated the marriage with her in a tent belonging to her, and she later died there.’” End.

This is a mursal report, from Maymuna bint Khalid ibn Yazid ibn al-Asamm. The son of her other maternal aunt, Abd Allah ibn Abbas, contradicted him and asserted categorically that he had married her while in ihram.

This report is in Sahih al-Bukhari. Disagreement concerning this ruling became widespread among the jurists. Some reconciled the reports by saying that he contracted the marriage with her while in ihram, but consummated the marriage with her at al-Tan'im after he had left ihram following his 'umra, while free of ihram—

segments.arabic:
في الحلّ، وذلك بيّن من سياق القصّة عند ابن إسحاق. وقيل: عقد له عليها قبل أنّ يحرم، وانتشر أمر تزويجها بعد أن أحرم، فاشتبه الأمر.
وقد ذكر الزّهريّ وقتادة أنها التي وهبت نفسها للنّبيّ ﵌، فنزلت فيها الآية. وقيل الواهبة غيرها. وقيل إنهن تعدّدن، وهو الأقرب.
قال ابن سعد: كانت آخر امرأة تزوّجها- يعني ممن دخل بها، وذكر بسند له أنه تزوّجها في شوال سنة سبع، فإن ثبت صحّ أنه تزوّجها وهو حلال، لأنه إنما أحرم في ذي القعدة منها، وذكر بسند له فيه الواقديّ إلى علي بن عبد اللَّه بن عباس، قال: لما أراد رسول اللَّه ﵌ الخروج إلى مكّة للعمرة بعث أوس بن خولي، وأبا رافع إلى العبّاس ليزوّجه ميمونة، فأضلّا بعيريهما، فأقاما أياما ببطن رابغ إلى أن قدم رسول اللَّه ﵌، فوجدا بعيريهما، فسارا معه حتى قدما مكّة، فأرسل إلى العبّاس يذكر ذلك له فجعلت أمرها إلى رسول اللَّه ﵌، فجاء إلى منزل العباس فخطبها إلى العبّاس فزوّجها إيّاه.
ومن طريق سليمان بن يسار أن النّبيّ ﵌ بعث أبا رافع، وآخر يزوّجانه ميمونة قبل أن يخرج من المدينة.
وأخرج ابن سعد أيضا من طريق عبد الكريم، عن ميمون بن مهران، قال: دخلت على صفية بنت شيبة وهي كبيرة، فسألتها أتزوّج رسول اللَّه ﵌ ميمونة وهو محرّم؟ فقالت: لا، واللَّه، لقد تزوّجها وإنهما لحلالان.
وقال ابن سعد: حدّثنا أبو نعيم، حدّثنا هشام بن سعد، عن عطاء الخراسانيّ، قلت لابن المسيّب: إن عكرمة يزعم أنّ رسول اللَّه ﵌ تزوّج ميمونة وهو محرم، فقال: سأحدّثك، قدم رسول اللَّه ﵌ وهو محرم، فلما حلّ تزوّجها.
وقال ابن سعد: حدّثنا محمد بن عمر، وأنبأنا ابن جريج، عن أبي الزّبير، عن عكرمة- أنّ ميمونة بنت الحارث وهبت نفسها لرسول اللَّه ﵌. وعن محمد بن عمر، عن موسى بن محمد بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه، عن عمرة، قال: قيل لها إنّ ميمونة وهبت نفسها: فقالت: تزوّجها رسول اللَّه ﷺ على مهر خمسمائة درهم، وولي نكاحه إياها العبّاس.
وأخرج ابن سعد بسند صحيح إلى ابن عباس، قال: قال رسول اللَّه ﷺ. «الأخوات مؤمنات: ميمونة، وأمّ الفضل، وأسماء» .
وقال ابن سعد: أخبرنا كثير بن هشام، حدّثنا

in the non-sacred territory. This is clear from the course of the account as related by Ibn Ishaq. It has also been said that the marriage contract with her was concluded for him before he entered ihram, but news of his marriage to her spread after he had entered ihram, and thus the matter became confused.

al-Zuhri and Qatada stated that she was the woman who offered herself to the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—and that the verse was revealed concerning her. It has also been said that the woman who offered herself was someone else; and it has been said that there were several such women, which is the more likely view.

Ibn Sa'd said: She was the last woman he married—meaning, among those with whom he consummated marriage. He cited through an isnad of his that he married her in Shawwal of year seven. If this is established, it confirms that he married her while not in ihram, because he entered ihram only in Dhu al-Qa'da of that year. He also cited through an isnad of his containing al-Waqidi, going back to Ali ibn Abd Allah ibn Abbas, who said: When the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—intended to depart for Mecca to perform the lesser pilgrimage, he sent Aws ibn Khawli and Abu Rafi' to al-Abbas so that the latter might marry Maymuna to him. The two men lost their camels and remained for several days at Batn Rabigh, until the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—arrived. They then found their camels and traveled with him until they reached Mecca. He sent word to al-Abbas mentioning the matter to him. She placed her affairs in the hands of the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—who then came to al-Abbas's residence and asked al-Abbas for her hand, and al-Abbas married her to him.

Through Sulayman ibn Yasar, it is related that the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—sent Abu Rafi' and another man to arrange his marriage to Maymuna before he departed from Medina.

Ibn Sa'd also transmitted, through Abd al-Karim, from Maymun ibn Mihran, who said: I entered upon Safiyya bint Shayba when she was elderly and asked her, “Did the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—marry Maymuna while he was in ihram?” She replied, “No, by Allah! He certainly married her while both of them were free of ihram.”

Ibn Sa'd said: Abu Nu'aym related to us: Hisham ibn Sa'd related to us, from Ata al-Khurasani, who said: I said to Ibn al-Musayyib, “Ikrima asserts that the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—married Maymuna while he was in ihram.” He replied, “I shall tell you: the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—arrived while in ihram, and when he had left ihram, he married her.”

Ibn Sa'd said: Muhammad ibn Umar related to us, and Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Ikrima, that Maymuna bint al-Harith offered herself to the Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace. And from Muhammad ibn Umar, from Musa ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Amra, who said: She was told that Maymuna had offered herself, and she replied, “The Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—married her for a bridal gift of five hundred dirhams, and al-Abbas took charge of his marriage to her.”

Ibn Sa'd transmitted through a sound isnad going back to Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—said, “The sisters are believing women: Maymuna, Umm al-Fadl, and Asma.”

Ibn Sa'd said: Kathir ibn Hisham informed us: We were told by—

segments.arabic:
جعفر بن برقان، حدّثنا يزيد بن الأصمّ، قال: تلقيت عائشة من مكّة أنا وابن طلحة من أختها، وقد كنّا وقفنا على حائط من حيطان المدينة، فأصبنا منه، فبلغها ذلك، فأقبلت على ابن أختها تلومه، ثم أقبلت عليّ فوعظتني موعظة بليغة، ثم قالت: أما علمت أنّ اللَّه ساقك حتى جعلك في بيت من بيوت نبيّه، ذهبت واللَّه ميمونة ورمى بحبلك على غاربك، أما إنها كانت من أتقانا للَّه وأوصلنا للرّحم. وهذا سند صحيح.
وقال أيضا: حدّثنا أبو نعيم، حدّثنا جعفر بن برقان، أخبرني ميمون بن مهران: سألت صفية بنت شيبة، فقالت: تزوّج رسول اللَّه ﵌ ميمونة بسرف «١» وبنى بها في قبّة لها، وماتت بسرف، ودفنت في موضع قبّتنا، وكانت وفاة ميمونة سنة إحدى وخمسين.
ونقل ابن سعد عن الواقديّ أنها ماتت سنة إحدى وستين، قال: وهي آخر من مات من أزواج النبيّ ﷺ. انتهى.
ولولا هذا الكلام الأخير لاحتمل أن يكون قوله وستين وهما من بعض الرّواة، ولكن دل أثر عائشة الّذي حكاه عنها يزيد بن الأصمّ أنّ عائشة ماتت قبل الستين بلا خلاف، والأثر المذكور صحيح، فهو أولى من قول الواقديّ.
وقد جزم يعقوب بن سفيان بأنها ماتت سنة تسع وأربعين، وقال غيره: ماتت سنة ثلاث وستين. وقيل: سنة ست وستين، وكلاهما غير ثابت. والأول أثبت.
segments.english:
Ja'far ibn Burqan related to us: Yazid ibn al-Asamm said: Ibn Talha, the son of her sister, and I went out to meet Aisha as she came from Mecca. We had stopped at one of the orchards of Medina and taken something from it. When this reached her, she turned to her sister's son and reproached him. Then she turned to me and admonished me eloquently. She then said, “Did you not know that Allah led you along until He placed you in one of the houses of His Prophet? By Allah, Maymuna has gone, and your rope has been cast upon your withers. Indeed, she was among those of us who feared Allah most and maintained ties of kinship most faithfully.” This is a sound chain of transmission.

He also said: Abu Nu'aym related to us: Ja'far ibn Burqan related to us: Maimun ibn Mihran informed me: I asked Safiyya bint Shayba, and she said, “The Messenger of Allah married Maymuna at Sarif,(1) consummated the marriage with her there in a pavilion belonging to her, and she died at Sarif and was buried at the site of our pavilion.” Maymuna's death occurred in the year 51 AH.

Ibn Sa'd transmitted from al-Waqidi that she died in the year 61 AH. He said, “She was the last of the Prophet's wives to die.” End quote.

Were it not for this last statement, it would be possible that the words “and sixty” were an error on the part of one of the transmitters. However, the report from Aisha that Yazid ibn al-Asamm related from her proves the point, since Aisha died before the year 60 AH without disagreement. The aforementioned report is sound and therefore takes precedence over al-Waqidi's statement.

Ya'qub ibn Sufyan stated categorically that she died in the year 49 AH. Another said that she died in the year 63 AH, and it has also been said that it was in the year 66 AH. Neither of these two statements is established; the first is the best established.
